```{r}
packages <- c("here", "readr", "dplyr", "purrr", "stringr")
to_install <- setdiff(packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

here::i_am("scripts/S2 Merging Datasets.Rmd")
in_dir  <- here("dataset", "row")
out_dir <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s2")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

files <- list.files(
  path = in_dir,
  pattern = "_12h_1hTable_corr_for_efficiency_ascii\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
) |> sort()


length(files)
head(files, 2)
tail(files, 2)

read_nmdb_year <- function(f) {
  df <- readr::read_csv(
    f,
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )

  # ç»ä¸ datetime åå
  if (!("datetime" %in% names(df))) {
    # ååºï¼æ¾å¯è½çæ¶é´å
    time_candidates <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "date|time")]
    if (length(time_candidates) == 0) stop("No time column in: ", basename(f))
    df <- df %>% rename(datetime = all_of(time_candidates[1]))
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, tz = "UTC")
    ) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
}

dfs <- purrr::map(files, read_nmdb_year)

# çºµååå¹¶ï¼èªå¨å¯¹é½åï¼ç¼ºçåè¡¥ NAï¼
merged <- dplyr::bind_rows(dfs) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  distinct(datetime, .keep_all = TRUE)   # å»æè·¨å¹´ä»½è¾¹çå¯è½éå¤çæ¶é´ç¹

# å¯éï¼æ£æ¥ç¼ºå¤±æ¯ä¾ï¼çåªäº station å¾å¤ NAï¼
na_rate <- merged %>%
  summarise(across(-datetime, ~ mean(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "station", values_to = "na_rate") %>%
  arrange(desc(na_rate))

print(head(na_rate, 10))

out_path <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s2", "nmdb_merged_2000_2026.csv")
readr::write_csv(merged, out_path)

out_path
dim(merged)

```

### Table with starttime and endtime.

```{r}
# --------------------------
# S2 (add this chunk AFTER you have created nmdb_merged_2000_2026.csv)
# Task: station coverage table with readable start/end datetime
# Output:
#   outcomes/nmdb_station_coverage_start_end.csv
#   outcomes/nmdb_station_coverage_start_end_by_day.csv (optional)
# --------------------------

packages2 <- c("tidyr", "lubridate", "tibble", "dplyr", "readr")
to_install2 <- setdiff(packages2, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install2) > 0) install.packages(to_install2)

library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

merged_path <- here("dataset", "outcomes",  "from_s2", "nmdb_merged_2000_2026.csv")
dat <- readr::read_csv(merged_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

# --- FIX 1: robust datetime parsing for strings like 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    datetime_raw = as.character(datetime),
    datetime_raw = stringr::str_replace_all(datetime_raw, "T", " "),
    datetime_raw = stringr::str_replace_all(datetime_raw, "Z$", ""),
    datetime = suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd_hms(datetime_raw, tz = "UTC"))
  )

# fallback for still-failed parses
if (any(is.na(dat$datetime))) {
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      datetime = ifelse(
        is.na(datetime),
        as.character(datetime_raw),
        as.character(datetime)  # temporarily character for parse_date_time
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      datetime = lubridate::parse_date_time(
        datetime,
        orders = c("Y-m-d H:M:S", "Y-m-d H:M", "Y-m-d"),
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
}

# if still NA, stop early with a helpful message
n_bad <- sum(is.na(dat$datetime))
if (n_bad > 0) {
  bad_examples <- unique(dat$datetime_raw[is.na(dat$datetime)])[1:min(5, n_bad)]
  stop(
    "datetime parse still failing for ", n_bad, " rows. Examples: ",
    paste(bad_examples, collapse = " | ")
  )
}

dat <- dat %>% select(-datetime_raw)

# --- FIX 2: infer timestep safely ---
dt_step <- dat %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  summarise(step = as.numeric(stats::median(diff(datetime), na.rm = TRUE), units = "secs")) %>%
  pull(step)
if (is.na(dt_step) || dt_step <= 0) dt_step <- 12 * 3600

n_total <- nrow(dat)

coverage_tbl <- dat %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -datetime,
    names_to = "station",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(
    start_dt = if (all(is.na(value))) as.POSIXct(NA) else min(datetime[!is.na(value)]),
    end_dt   = if (all(is.na(value))) as.POSIXct(NA) else max(datetime[!is.na(value)]),
    n_obs    = sum(!is.na(value)),
    n_total  = n_total,
    coverage_pct = ifelse(n_total > 0, 100 * n_obs / n_total, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # å³é®ï¼ç¨ if_else ä¿æ POSIXct ç±»åï¼end = last timestamp + 1 step
    end_dt_interval = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(end_dt),
      as.POSIXct(NA, tz = "UTC"),
      end_dt + lubridate::seconds(dt_step)
    ),

    # ååºç» Excel ççå¯è¯»æ¶é´å­ç¬¦ä¸²
    start_datetime = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(start_dt),
      NA_character_,
      format(start_dt, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
    ),
    end_datetime = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(end_dt_interval),
      NA_character_,
      format(end_dt_interval, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(station, start_datetime, end_datetime, n_obs, n_total, coverage_pct) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_obs), station)


out_cov <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s2", "nmdb_station_coverage_start_end.csv")
readr::write_csv(coverage_tbl, out_cov)

out_cov
print(head(coverage_tbl, 15))

# Optional: "by day" version (a day is observed if ANY timestamp that day is non-missing)
coverage_by_day <- dat %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(datetime, date), names_to = "station", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(station, date) %>%
  summarise(any_obs = any(!is.na(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(
    start_date = if (all(!any_obs)) NA else min(date[any_obs]),
    end_date   = if (all(!any_obs)) NA else max(date[any_obs]),
    n_days_obs = sum(any_obs),
    n_days_total = n_distinct(date),
    coverage_pct = ifelse(n_days_total > 0, 100 * n_days_obs / n_days_total, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_days_obs), station)

out_cov_day <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s2", "nmdb_station_coverage_start_end_by_day.csv")
readr::write_csv(coverage_by_day, out_cov_day)

out_cov_day

```

```{r}
# --------------------------
# Task:
# Make a table with lat/lon for a given list of stations,
# reading from: dataset/row/nmdb_stations_final.csv
# Save to: dataset/outcomes/nmdb_selected_stations_latlon.csv
# --------------------------

packages3 <- c("here", "readr", "dplyr", "stringr")
to_install3 <- setdiff(packages3, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install3) > 0) install.packages(to_install3)

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

here::i_am("scripts/S2 Merging Datasets.Rmd")

out_dir <- here("dataset", "outcomes",  "from_s2")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1) your station list (exactly as you provided)
target_stations <- c(
  "OULU","JUNG","JUNG1","APTY","THUL","KERG","NEWK","INVK","MXCO","MOSC",
  "AATB","FSMT","NAIN","ATHN","LMKS","NANM","PWNK","ROME","SOPO","TERA",
  "SOPB","HRMS","DRBS","MRNY","PSNM","SNAE","TSMB","BKSN","MGDN","KIEL",
  "PTFM","SANB","KIEL2","DOMC","MCRL","DOMB","IRKT","ESOI","JBGO","IRK3",
  "NRLK","DJON","IRK2","CALM","ARNM","NEU3","AATA","CHAC","NVBK"
) %>% toupper()

# 2) read station meta table (nmdb_stations_final.csv)
meta_path <- here("dataset", "row", "nmdb_stations_final.csv")

stations_meta <- readr::read_csv(meta_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

# robust: pick station column (usually "station")
station_col <- if ("station" %in% names(stations_meta)) "station" else names(stations_meta)[1]

stations_meta <- stations_meta %>%
  rename(station = all_of(station_col)) %>%
  mutate(station = toupper(as.character(station))) %>%
  # ensure lat/lon columns exist
  mutate(
    lat = if ("lat" %in% names(.)) lat else NA_real_,
    lon = if ("lon" %in% names(.)) lon else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lat = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lat)),
    lon = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lon))
  )

# 3) check which target stations are missing from meta
meta_stations <- stations_meta %>% distinct(station) %>% pull(station)
missing_in_meta <- setdiff(target_stations, meta_stations) %>% sort()

# 4) build the final table (only target stations, with their lat/lon and other optional columns)
selected_latlon <- stations_meta %>%
  filter(station %in% target_stations) %>%
  distinct(station, lat, lon, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(match(station, target_stations))

# 5) (optional) report stations with missing lat/lon
missing_latlon <- selected_latlon %>%
  filter(is.na(lat) | is.na(lon)) %>%
  pull(station) %>%
  sort()

# 6) save output
out_path <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s2", "nmdb_selected_stations_latlon.csv")
readr::write_csv(selected_latlon %>% select(station, lat, lon), out_path)

out_path

cat("Target station count:", length(target_stations), "\n")
cat("Found in nmdb_stations_final:", nrow(selected_latlon), "\n")

if (length(missing_in_meta) > 0) {
  cat("Missing in nmdb_stations_final.csv (station not found):\n")
  print(missing_in_meta)
} else {
  cat("All target stations exist in nmdb_stations_final.csv.\n")
}

if (length(missing_latlon) > 0) {
  cat("Stations found but lat/lon is missing:\n")
  print(missing_latlon)
} else {
  cat("All found stations have non-missing lat/lon.\n")
}

```
